1722-1829-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1722-1829-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Vindictive Vampire triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

6-2085-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Kelpie Guide doesn't have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-2085-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

3899-4186-6872.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
3899-4186-6872.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1263-2921-4871-6026.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2438-3249-5111-5173.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

4222-5268-7734.description:
Activate Wakandan Tusker by tapping it, adding {U}.
Wakandan Tusker triggers, causing you to scry 1 and gain 1 life
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Wakandan Tusker.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3908-7009-7715.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-7009-7715.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, The Mighty Thor triggers, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

1496-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

423-1437-3819-5233.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1437-3819-5233.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Cultivator Colossus spell three times.
Resolve the first Cultivator Colossus copy.
The Cultivator Colossus token enters the battlefield, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield, drawing a card, and choosing not to repeat the process.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.
423-1437-3819-5233.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to the landfall card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3990-4038-5963.easyPrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3990-4038-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Incubation Druid's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

3536-5173-5553-5626.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Chthonian Nightmare"
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 2

4094-4571-5702.easyPrerequisites:
At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4094-4571-5702.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Life
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 5.

277-681-4693-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
277-681-4693-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat from step 2.

527-1978-5056.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
527-1978-5056.description:
Cause Selvala to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Selvala.
Repeat from step 2.

4871-5695-5752-6797.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Brokkos.
When Brokkos dies, Infested Thrinax and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Infested Thrinax trigger, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Phantom Train four times by sacrificing four Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U/B}{G}{G}.
Cast Brokkos from your graveyard for its mutate cost by paying {2}{U/B}{G}{G}, putting it on top of a Saproling.
Repeat from step 3.

4659-5365-5494-6774.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
4659-5365-5494-6774.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1322-2457-4289-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

864-2103-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
864-2103-5626.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
864-2103-5626.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Eternal Witness, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

486-4096-4853-5167.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
486-4096-4853-5167.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Goblin Welder to become an artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Dross Scorpion and returning Esper Sojourners from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing Esper Sojourners and returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Esper Sojourners triggers, untapping Goblin Welder.
Repeat from step 2.

1988-2762-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Thopter Squadron.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-2762-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron.
Activate Thopter Squadron' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1348-2179-3206-3664-4806.notablePrerequisites: Manascape Refractor does not have summoning sickness.
1348-2179-3206-3664-4806.description:
Activate Manascape Refractor using Blinkmoth Nexus' second ability by paying {1}.
Kurkesh triggers, choose not to pay.
Resolve the Manascape Refractor ability, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature until end of turn.
Declare Manascape Refractor as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Manascape Refractor.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Maze of Ith's ability by tapping it, targeting itself.
Kurkesh triggers, causing you to pay {R} to copy Manascape Refractor's ability, targeting Manascape Refractor.
Resolve the copy of Manascape Refractor's ability, untapping it.
Activate Manascape Refractor using Lotus Field's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the original Manascape Refractor ability from step 6, untapping it.
Repeat from step 6.

372-2902-5276.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2902-5276.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Leonin Relic-Warder until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Journey to Nowhere from exile to the battlefield.
Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from exile to the battlefield.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Journey to Nowhere.
Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
